title: News article (web)
description: A screenshot of a local news website article: masthead, section, headline, dek, byline, hero photo with caption, opening paragraphs. Write in AP news style: short paragraphs, attribution for every claim, quotes from bystanders and officials, 'did not respond to a request for comment' where relevant.

outlet.description: Publication name in the masthead (prefer brand.aliases.localNews when generating)

outletDomain.description: Site domain shown in the browser bar

label.description: Red story label before the section

examples: Hacked screens, stranded bags: What we know about the chaos at NCIA
Airport officials have not said whether the outage was a cyberattack.

heroImageBrief.description: Image-generation brief for the hero photo slot (media stage only; never rely on legible text in it)
examples: passengers under rows of dark departure screens, editorial press photo
Travelers wait beneath departure boards at NCIA on Tuesday.

body.description: Article text; blank lines separate paragraphs. The screenshot shows roughly the first 5–7 paragraphs.
examples: CLEVELAND — Departure screens at Northeast Central Interstate Airport...
